svg.text: Pick a problem, see it lit on the wall, log the send. Everything on the phone, lights over Bluetooth, no account.
Recovery paths: Bluetooth off, permission blocked, no board found, lights look wrong, lights dropped mid-problem. Each one ends in "Climb without lights".
Home, Hang, Climb, Log, Settings. Workouts leave
Home for Hang; the calendar becomes a heat calendar
The benchmark list ships inside the app: about 1.5
MB for 1,960 problems. No download, no sign-in.
Every screen works without the LED kit. Bluetooth is
asked for only on Connect lights.
Four corners prove wiring and orientation before the
first problem, with a fix for each failure.
Thumbnails in every row, a full board on the
problem, big actions reachable with chalky hands.
Problems climbed in a fixed order. Sent it or Skip
lights the next one. No timer and no rests.
Problems, sends, own problems and the paired board
live on the device. Bluetooth is not a network.
No Moon login, so no sync with the official logbook.
Home reads only the last problem name. Board data
and Bluetooth load when Climb opens.
Same palette and Geist Mono. Three new colours, only
Which list may we ship, and under what terms? The
draft uses the public late-2023 benchmark list.
Boards here are schematic. Real hold shapes per set
The protocol is proven on the V1 box. V4 and V5
boxes are assumed to speak it; test on one.
No clear command is documented. An empty problem
should blank the wall; confirm on a board.
Not in the benchmark data yet. Add when a problem
Web Bluetooth is Chrome-only. Web may stay a browse-
A problem is one line of text over Bluetooth serial:
each hold as an LED number tagged start, hold or
Each message redraws the wall. No brightness, no
fades, no blinking, only fixed colours.
The app knows the link is up, not what is lit. That
is why the corner test asks the climber.
LEDs run up one column and down the next from A1.
Mirrored or reversed strips are fixed in the app.
One flag asks V2 and newer kits to also light above
each hold. It is the only light setting.
A V1 box takes a single connection. A board another
phone holds may not show up.
Longer messages are cut off without warning, so own
Newer kits also take left, right, match and foot
tags. Not used in this draft.
